summary: Laguna 2nd District representative with 90 principal-authored bills. Authored free annual medical check-ups, a cancer medicine fund, DSWD crisis assistance, social worker pay, barangay health worker Magna Carta, universal school feeding, primary health care, telemedicine, wage transparency in job ads, FOI, an anti-dynasty ban and penalties for nuisance candidates. Also authored a bill penalizing false information.
caveat: One extractor line (HB02502, 'mandatory immunization program repeal') was ambiguous and not scored. Disinformation bill is a single speech issue and civil liberties is unscored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored free annual check-ups, a cancer medicine fund and primary care expansion (-3), DSWD crisis aid and universal school feeding (-3), social worker and health worker pay (-2) and wage transparency in job ads (-2).
